about: What each tower can pop, per crosspath. Hand-entered facts (damage_types, towers) plus a section derived from them by tools/build_bloon_kb.py (counters). btd6bot/threats.py reads this file; docs/bloons.md explains it.
source: Well-established BTD6 facts (v57), consistent with the repo's earlier bloonswiki research (data/rounds.json answers, docs/rounds.md). NOT yet checked against the game's own simulation model: when data/game_model/towers.json + upgrades.json exist, tools/build_bloon_kb.py cross-checks every fact it can find there and lists disagreements under crosscheck.

confidence_levels.game_model: confirmed by data/game_model (the game's own numbers) - counted by the bot
confidence_levels.established: well-known BTD6 fact, agrees with earlier research in this repo - counted by the bot
confidence_levels.likely: believed true but not confirmed - documented only, NEVER counted when the bot decides whether a threat is covered
confidence_levels.unknown: no reliable fact - the tower is never counted for that property

conventions.min: the attack/ability exists once the tower has at least these tiers on every path ("0-0-2" = bottom path tier 2+)
conventions.max: the attack exists only while the tower has at most these tiers (an upgrade that REPLACES the attack, e.g. Tack 3-x-x Hot Shots turns every tack into fire)
conventions.type: damage type of the attack; damage_types says which bloon properties it cannot pop
conventions.blimp: false when the attack cannot hurt MOAB-class bloons (Ice Monkey freeze)
conventions.camo.how: detect = the tower targets camo bloons; track = its damage lies on the track and hits camo without targeting; untargeted = it fires without a target; decamo = it strips camo from the bloons it hits, so every tower downstream sees them
conventions.auras.grant: camo = every tower in range detects camo (Radar Scanner); all_types = every tower in range pops every bloon type (Monkey Intelligence Bureau); deregrow = bloons in range cannot regrow
conventions.conservative choices: when an attack's damage type is uncertain, it is entered as the type that pops LESS: a 'hot' upgrade that may be Fire or Normal is entered as fire (both pop lead and black, only fire fails against purple); the Wizard's Fireball, Fire or Explosion, is fire_or_explosion (pops neither black nor purple). The bot then never believes it can pop something it might not.

normal.what: pops everything (Juggernaut balls, Full Metal Jacket bullets, Flash/Sticky Bombs, Cold Snap)

sharp.what: darts, tacks, shurikens, spikes, thorns, bullets

fire.what: Hot Shots, Ring of Fire, Wall of Fire, Dragon's Breath, burning

cold.what: the Ice Monkey's freeze; MOAB-class cannot be frozen

energy.what: the Wizard's magic bolts, Super Monkey Laser Blasts, Dartling lasers

plasma.what: Super Monkey Plasma Blasts / Sun Avatar, Apache Prime

fire_or_explosion.what: an attack whose type is uncertain between fire and explosion (Wizard Fireball): counted as popping neither black nor purple

glacier.what: Cold Snap's freeze (the game model: pops lead, black and purple, not white)

blimp_dps.about: Rough single-target damage per second against MOAB-class bloons, unbuffed, from the commonly quoted upgrade stats (bloonswiki numbers already in docs/rounds.md where available). Order-of-magnitude estimates for the blimp ramp check only; every entry applies once the tower has at least that crosspath, and the highest matching entry wins. Towers without an entry here use the figures derived from the game model (model_towers.<tower>.blimp_dps).
